apply-pkcs7-detached-digital-signature.title: Apply PKCS#7 Detached Digital Signature to PDF
apply-pkcs7-detached-digital-signature.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a file stream, adding a signature field, and applying a PKCS#7 detached digital signature using a PFX certificate.

batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate.title: Batch Sign PDFs with Certificate and Timestamp
batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over PDF files in a folder and apply a PKCS#7 digital signature using a PFX certificate, adding a timestamp from a TSA. The signed PDFs are saved back to the original location.

encrypt-pdf-disable-printing.title: Encrypt PDF with Password and Disable Printing
encrypt-pdf-disable-printing.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using AES‑256 with user and owner passwords while restricting permissions to prevent printing.

encrypt-pdf-owner-password-high-res-prin.title: Encrypt PDF with Owner Password and Allow High‑Resolution Printing
encrypt-pdf-owner-password-high-res-prin.description: The example loads a PDF, applies AES‑256 encryption with an owner password, enables high‑resolution printing while disabling copying, and saves the protected document.

decrypt-pdf-with-owner-password.title: Decrypt PDF with Owner Password using Aspose.Pdf
decrypt-pdf-with-owner-password.description: Demonstrates opening an encrypted PDF with the owner password, removing its protection, and saving the decrypted document.

add-visible-digital-signature-second-pag.title: Add Visible Digital Signature to Second Page of PDF
add-visible-digital-signature-second-pag.description: Demonstrates how to place a visible digital signature in the bottom‑right corner of the second page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-invisible-digital-signature-to-pdf.title: Add Invisible Digital Signature to PDF
add-invisible-digital-signature-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create an invisible digital signature field, sign it with a PKCS#7 certificate, record the signing time, and save the PDF without altering its layout using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-signature-field-metadata.title: Extract Signature Field Metadata from PDF
extract-signature-field-metadata.description: Loads a PDF, checks for form fields, and iterates over all signature fields to output their properties, signature details, and extracts any embedded certificate or image.

extract-images-from-signed-pdf.title: Extract Images from a Signed PDF and Save as PNG
extract-images-from-signed-pdf.description: The example loads a signed PDF, extracts any signature field images, then iterates through each page to save all embedded images as PNG files.

remove-digital-signature-from-pdf.title: Remove Digital Signature from PDF
remove-digital-signature-from-pdf.description: Shows how to programmatically strip a digital signature from a PDF when privileges allow, using signature sanitization and explicit removal of signature field annotations.

sign-pdf-with-smart-card.title: Sign PDF with Smart Card Certificate
sign-pdf-with-smart-card.description: Shows how to load a PDF, add a signature field, and sign it using a smart‑card certificate (private key) via Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-with-smart-card-no-pin.title: Sign PDF with Smart Card Certificate (No PIN Prompt)
sign-pdf-with-smart-card-no-pin.description: Shows how to add a visible signature field to a PDF and sign it using a smart‑card X509Certificate2 without displaying a PIN prompt, leveraging Aspose.Pdf.

custom-security-handler-logging-pdf-acce.title: Custom Security Handler for Logging PDF Access Attempts
custom-security-handler-logging-pdf-acce.description: Demonstrates how to implement a custom ICustomSecurityHandler that logs password checks and encryption steps, then encrypts and opens a PDF using this handler.

restrict-copy-paste-in-pdf.title: Restrict Copy-Paste in PDF with Encryption
restrict-copy-paste-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set permissions to allow printing and modification while disabling content extraction (copy‑paste).

sign-pdf-with-timestamp.title: Sign PDF with Timestamp from TSA
sign-pdf-with-timestamp.description: Shows how to add a digital PKCS#7 signature to a PDF and request a trusted timestamp from a Time‑Stamp Authority using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-digital-signature.title: Validate PDF Digital Signature with Certificate Chain Check
validate-pdf-digital-signature.description: Loads a PDF, locates the first signature field, configures validation options to check the certificate chain, and verifies the detached PKCS#7 signature.

validate-pdf-signature-ocsp.title: Validate PDF Signature Using OCSP
validate-pdf-signature-ocsp.description: Demonstrates how to load a signed PDF, configure OCSP validation options, and verify each digital signature's revocation status using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-signature-crl.title: Validate PDF Signature Using CRL Revocation Checking
validate-pdf-signature-crl.description: Shows how to load a signed PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set ValidationOptions to use CRL distribution points, and verify each signature field's revocation status.

extract-pdf-signature-signing-time-utc.title: Extract PDF Signature Signing Time and Convert to UTC
extract-pdf-signature-signing-time-utc.description: Loads a signed PDF, locates signature fields, reads the stored signing date, and converts it to UTC format.

extract-certificate-chain-from-pdf-signa.title: Extract Certificate Chain from PDF Signature and Save as DER Files
extract-certificate-chain-from-pdf-signa.description: Loads a signed PDF, extracts the X509 certificate from each signature field, builds its certificate chain, and writes each certificate in DER format to disk.

sign-pdf-with-reason-contact-location.title: Sign PDF with Reason, Contact Info, and Location
sign-pdf-with-reason-contact-location.description: Demonstrates how to add a digital signature field to a PDF and sign it using a PKCS#7 certificate while populating the Reason, ContactInfo, and Location properties.

sign-pdf-with-custom-image-appearance.title: Sign PDF with Custom Image Appearance
sign-pdf-with-custom-image-appearance.description: Demonstrates how to add a visible digital signature to a PDF using a custom PNG image as the signature appearance and a PFX certificate.

certified-pdf-signature-allow-add-pages.title: Create a Certified PDF Signature Allowing Page Additions
certified-pdf-signature-allow-add-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add a certification (MDP) signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so that new pages can be appended after signing.

sign-pdf-lock-specific-form-fields.title: Sign PDF and Lock Specific Form Fields
sign-pdf-lock-specific-form-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding or using a signature field, applying a PKCS#7 digital signature, and setting selected form fields to read‑only after signing.

sign-pdf-and-lock-readonly.title: Sign PDF and Enforce Read‑Only Mode
sign-pdf-and-lock-readonly.description: Demonstrates how to add a digital signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then set the document to append‑only mode so the file becomes read‑only after signing.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-user-owner-passwords.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Set User/Owner Passwords
encrypt-pdf-aes256-user-owner-passwords.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using AES‑256, assign separate user and owner passwords, and configure basic permissions before saving the document.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-bit-restrict-editing.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 128-bit and Restrict Editing
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-bit-restrict-editing.description: The example loads a PDF, applies 128‑bit RC4 encryption with user and owner passwords, restricts permissions to printing only, and saves the encrypted document.

decrypt-pdf-extract-embedded-images.title: Decrypt PDF and Extract Embedded Images
decrypt-pdf-extract-embedded-images.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with a user password, remove its encryption, and extract all embedded images to PNG files.

decrypt-pdf-update-metadata.title: Decrypt PDF and Update Metadata with Aspose.Pdf
decrypt-pdf-update-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open an encrypted PDF using the owner password, remove its encryption, modify document metadata, and save the result.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-by-filename.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs Using File Name Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdfs-by-filename.description: Iterates through all PDF files in a folder, derives a password from each file name, encrypts each document with AES‑256 using Aspose.Pdf, and saves the encrypted copies to an output directory.

batch-decrypt-pdfs-lookup-table.title: Batch Decrypt Password-Protected PDFs Using a Lookup Table
batch-decrypt-pdfs-lookup-table.description: Demonstrates iterating over a folder of encrypted PDFs, trying multiple possible passwords from a dictionary, decrypting each document with Aspose.Pdf, and saving the unprotected version.

batch-sign-pdfs-title-based-certificate-.title: Batch Sign PDFs with Title-Based Certificate Selection
batch-sign-pdfs-title-based-certificate-.description: Loads PDFs from a folder, selects a certificate based on the document title, creates a PKCS7 signature, adds or uses a signature field, signs each document, and saves the signed files to an output folder.

batch-encrypt-and-sign-pdfs.title: Batch Encrypt and Digitally Sign PDFs
batch-encrypt-and-sign-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt multiple PDF files with AES‑256 and then apply a PKCS#7 digital signature to each encrypted document using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-signature-field-names-and-page-n.title: Extract Signature Field Names and Page Numbers from PDF
extract-signature-field-names-and-page-n.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over its form fields, identify signature fields, and retrieve each field's name and the page number it appears on.

retrieve-reason-location-from-pdf-signat.title: Retrieve Reason and Location from PDF Signatures
retrieve-reason-location-from-pdf-signat.description: Demonstrates loading a signed PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating over signature fields, and extracting the Reason and Location metadata from each digital signature.

sign-pdf-add-custom-xmp-metadata.title: Sign PDF and Embed Custom XMP Metadata
sign-pdf-add-custom-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to create a visible signature field, apply a PKCS#1 digital signature, and add custom XMP metadata describing the signing process using Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-with-pkcs7-and-custom-xml.title: Sign PDF with PKCS#7 and embed custom XML signature
sign-pdf-with-pkcs7-and-custom-xml.description: The example loads a PDF, creates a signature field, applies a PKCS#7 digital signature using a PFX certificate, demonstrates where to embed custom XML signature data, and saves the signed document.

sign-pdf-and-lock-signature-field.title: Sign PDF and Lock Signature Field
sign-pdf-and-lock-signature-field.description: Demonstrates how to add a digital signature to a PDF, make the signature field read‑only, and enable append‑only mode to prevent further modifications.

sign-pdf-with-incremental-updates.title: Sign PDF with Incremental Updates for Future Signatures
sign-pdf-with-incremental-updates.description: Demonstrates how to add a digital signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while enabling incremental updates so additional signatures can be appended later.

sign-pdf-prevent-additional-signatures.title: Sign PDF and Prevent Additional Signatures
sign-pdf-prevent-additional-signatures.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, enable append‑only mode to block further signatures, and save the final document.

encrypt-pdf-print-only-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with Print‑Only Permission
encrypt-pdf-print-only-permission.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and restrict its permissions so that only printing is allowed.

encrypt-pdf-allow-copy-block-print.title: Encrypt PDF and Allow Copying While Blocking Printing
encrypt-pdf-allow-copy-block-print.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set user and owner passwords, permit content extraction (copy) and disable printing, then save the protected file.

encrypt-pdf-with-print-copy-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with Printing and Copying Permissions
encrypt-pdf-with-print-copy-permissions.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set user and owner passwords, and enable printing and content extraction permissions.

encrypt-pdf-disable-content-extraction.title: Encrypt PDF and Disable Content Extraction
encrypt-pdf-disable-content-extraction.description: Loads a PDF, encrypts it with AES‑256 using user and owner passwords, sets permissions to none to block all content extraction, and saves the encrypted file.

decrypt-pdf-extract-images-reencrypt.title: Decrypt PDF, Extract Images, and Re‑encrypt with New Owner Password
decrypt-pdf-extract-images-reencrypt.description: The example opens an encrypted PDF using a known password, decrypts it, extracts all embedded images to a folder, then re‑encrypts the PDF with a new owner password and saves the result.

download-sign-pdf-azure-blob.title: Download PDF, Apply PKCS7 Signature, and Upload to Azure Blob
download-sign-pdf-azure-blob.description: The example downloads a PDF from a URL, creates a signature field, signs it with a PKCS7 certificate using Aspose.Pdf, and uploads the signed document to Azure Blob Storage.

encrypt-pdf-with-password-aes256.title: Encrypt PDF with Password (AES‑256)
encrypt-pdf-with-password-aes256.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array, applies AES‑256 encryption with a user password and optional owner password, and returns the encrypted PDF bytes.

sign-pdf-with-windows-certificate.title: Sign PDF with Windows Store Certificate using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-windows-certificate.description: Shows how to retrieve a certificate from the Windows personal store by thumbprint and apply it to a PDF signature field using Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-with-certificate.title: Sign PDF with a Certificate using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-certificate.description: Demonstrates loading a PFX certificate, creating a signature field on a PDF, and applying a digital signature with Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-hardware-token-pkcs11.title: Sign PDF using a hardware token (PKCS#11)
sign-pdf-hardware-token-pkcs11.description: Demonstrates how to add a signature field to a PDF and sign it with a certificate stored on a hardware token via the PKCS#11 interface using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-signature.title: Validate PDF Digital Signature with Aspose.Pdf
validate-pdf-signature.description: Loads a PDF, locates signature fields, and validates each digital signature using Aspose.Pdf's validation options and strict mode, reporting the validation status.

validate-pdf-signature-timestamp.title: Validate PDF Signature and Check Timestamp Against Certificate Validity
validate-pdf-signature-timestamp.description: Shows how to load a signed PDF, locate the first signature field, verify the signature using strict validation options, extract the signing timestamp, and (if the certificate is accessible) compare the timestamp to the certificate's validity period.

extract-signature-image-to-png.title: Extract Signature Image from PDF and Save as PNG
extract-signature-image-to-png.description: Demonstrates how to locate a signature field in a PDF, extract its appearance image, and write the image to a PNG file using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-signature-images.title: Extract Signature Field Images from PDF
extract-signature-images.description: Shows how to loop through signature fields in a PDF document and save each field's appearance as a JPEG image.

extract-images-from-signed-pdf__v2.title: Extract Images from Signed PDF into Page‑Specific Folders
extract-images-from-signed-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load a signed PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, extract all embedded images, and save them as PNG files in separate folders per page.

extract-signature-certificate-chain.title: Extract Signature Certificate Chain and Verify Expiration
extract-signature-certificate-chain.description: Loads a signed PDF, extracts the X509 certificate from each signature field, builds its certificate chain, and checks the expiration dates of the certificates.

custom-security-handler-warning-overlay.title: Custom Security Handler with Warning Overlay
custom-security-handler-warning-overlay.description: Shows how to attach a custom ICustomSecurityHandler to a PDF to disable copy‑paste permissions and add a visible warning annotation on each page using Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-flatten-signature.title: Sign PDF and Flatten Signature Appearance
sign-pdf-flatten-signature.description: Demonstrates how to add a digital signature to a PDF using a PKCS#7 certificate, then flatten the document so the signature appearance becomes a static part of the page.

sign-pdf-remove-annotations.title: Sign PDF and Remove Annotations While Preserving Signature
sign-pdf-remove-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF using a PFX certificate, then delete all regular annotations while keeping the signature field intact, and finally save the cleaned document.

encrypt-pdf-with-password.title: Encrypt PDF with Password and Permissions
encrypt-pdf-with-password.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, set specific permissions, and save the protected document.

encrypt-pdf-view-only-edit-password.title: Encrypt PDF for View-Only with Edit Password
encrypt-pdf-view-only-edit-password.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF so it can be opened and viewed without a password while requiring an owner password for any editing operations, using specific permissions.

decrypt-pdf-sign-fields-multiple-certs.title: Decrypt PDF and Sign Each Signature Field with Different Certificates
decrypt-pdf-sign-fields-multiple-certs.description: The example opens an encrypted PDF, removes its protection, locates all signature fields, and signs each field using a different PFX certificate, cycling through a list of certificates.

batch-sign-and-compress-pdfs.title: Batch Sign and Compress PDFs
batch-sign-and-compress-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over a folder of PDF files, add a digital signature field, sign each document with a PKCS#7 certificate, compress the signed PDF, and save the result.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-archive-zip.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs and Archive to ZIP
batch-encrypt-pdfs-archive-zip.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt multiple PDF files with unique passwords using Aspose.Pdf and then package the encrypted PDFs into a ZIP archive.

extract-digest-algorithm-from-pdf-signat.title: Extract Digest Algorithm from PDF Signatures
extract-digest-algorithm-from-pdf-signat.description: Loads a PDF, iterates over its form fields to find signature fields, and logs the digest hash algorithm used in each digital signature for compliance reporting.

sign-pdf-with-sha384-digest.title: Sign PDF with SHA‑384 Digest using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-sha384-digest.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF document using an external X509 certificate with the SHA‑384 digest algorithm via Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-with-sha512.title: Sign PDF with SHA‑512 Digest Using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-sha512.description: Loads a PDF, adds a signature field, and signs the document with a PFX certificate using the SHA‑512 digest algorithm, then saves the signed file.

sign-pdf-with-4096-rsa-certificate.title: Sign PDF with 4096‑bit RSA Certificate
sign-pdf-with-4096-rsa-certificate.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF using a 4096‑bit RSA private key stored in a PFX file with Aspose.Pdf, adding a visible signature field to the first page.

sign-pdf-with-ecc-p256.title: Sign PDF with ECC P‑256 Private Key
sign-pdf-with-ecc-p256.description: Shows how to load an ECC certificate, add a signature field, and apply a PKCS#7 signature using a custom ECDSA signer to create a compact signature on a PDF document.

encrypt-pdf-with-smart-card-certificate.title: Encrypt PDF with Smart Card Certificate
encrypt-pdf-with-smart-card-certificate.description: Shows how to retrieve a certificate from a smart card or HSM and encrypt a PDF so that only the certificate holder can open it, using Aspose.Pdf.

decrypt-pdf-with-certificate-token.title: Decrypt PDF Encrypted with Certificate Using Hardware Token
decrypt-pdf-with-certificate-token.description: Shows how to open a PDF encrypted with a public certificate, retrieve the private key from a hardware token, decrypt the document, and save the unencrypted version using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate-per-doc.title: Batch Sign PDFs with Certificate per Document Type
batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate-per-doc.description: Loads PDF files from an input folder, determines a document type from the PDF title, retrieves the corresponding certificate, signs all signature fields, and saves the signed PDFs to an output folder.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-date-password.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with Date-Based Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdfs-date-password.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt multiple PDF files in a folder using Aspose.Pdf, generating a unique password for each file from its name combined with the current UTC date.

add-new-empty-signature-field.title: Add a New Empty Signature Field to a PDF
add-new-empty-signature-field.description: The example loads a PDF, lists any existing signature fields, creates a new empty signature field on the first page, and saves the updated document.

sign-pdf-embed-xfa-form-data.title: Sign PDF and Embed Custom XFA Form Data
sign-pdf-embed-xfa-form-data.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, assigning custom XFA XML to its form, creating a signature field, and applying a PKCS#7 digital signature using a certificate.

validate-pdf-signature-extract-san.title: Validate PDF Signature and Extract SAN from Signing Certificate
validate-pdf-signature-extract-san.description: Demonstrates how to load a signed PDF, verify each signature using strict validation, and retrieve the signing certificate's Subject Alternative Name (SAN) entries.

encrypt-pdf-with-user-owner-passwords-re.title: Encrypt PDF with User and Owner Passwords and Remove User Password
encrypt-pdf-with-user-owner-passwords-re.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using both user and owner passwords, then open it with the owner password to remove the user password while keeping the document encrypted.

sign-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.title: Sign PDF and Flatten Form Fields
sign-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a digital signature field, applying a PKCS#7 signature, flattening all form fields to make them non‑editable, and saving the signed document.
